Motorista na TAP não é só quem dirige. É: A driver at TAP is not just someone who drives. It is the person who represents the company at the customer's door, knows every city on the route and cares for the cargo as if it were their own. That is why operations are designed around drivers:
<0>Rotas regionais e fixas.</0> A rede c: <0>Regional, fixed routes.</0> The network covers SP, PR and MS with daily routes between neighbouring branches. You know the road, the customers, and you return to your base.
<0>Frota cuidada e rastreada.</0> Caminh: <0>A well-kept, tracked fleet.</0> Serviced trucks monitored by satellite, with 24-hour support from the central office anywhere on the route.
<0>Voz na operação.</0> Quem está na est: <0>A voice in operations.</0> Those on the road help design the route. A driver's suggestion becomes a process improvement.
<0>Crescimento por dentro.</0> Ajudantes: <0>Growth from within.</0> Helpers who become drivers, drivers who become yard and branch leaders. Preference always goes to those already in the company.
Desde 2001 a TAP cresce com um jeito sim: Since 2001 TAP has grown in a simple way: keep our word, treat the person on the other side of the counter well and solve the problem instead of passing it on. Our values are <0>innovation</0>, <1>speed with safety</1>, <2>human capital</2> and <3>social responsibility</3>. In practice that means small teams per branch, managers who know every person by name and quick decisions.
